message.content:
The webpage is for Tostem, a company focused on Japanese innovation in window design. At the top left, the company name "TOSTEM" is displayed in a large, bold font, accompanied by a tagline "Japanese Innovation in Window Design" in a smaller font to its right. 

A navigation menu is situated below the company name, spanning the width of the page. The menu consists of seven items, each with a dropdown arrow: "ABOUT TOSTEM", "WHY TOSTEM", "OUR PRODUCTS", "TOSTEM EXPERIENCE", "KNOWLEDGE", and "REACH US". 

The main content area features a large, full-width image of a modern building with large windows, overlaid with text. The prominent text "Japanese Innovation" is displayed in a large, light gray font, followed by "Window Design" in a slightly smaller font. Below this, a paragraph reads: "Experience the perfect blend of Japanese precision engineering and elegant design with Tostem's premium aluminium windows and doors." 

On the left side of the page, there is a black vertical button with white text that says "DOWNLOAD BROCHURE". On the right side, a similar black vertical button with white text says "ENQUIRE NOW". 

At the bottom of the page, there is a pagination control with left and right arrows, and a series of dots indicating multiple pages. To the left of the pagination, there is a red button with a white "N" and the text "2 Issues" with an "x" next to it. On the far right, there is a blue upward arrow button. 

In the top right corner, there is a blue circular button with a white phone icon.
